study_area: Gosaba Mangrove Complex, Sundarbans Delta, West Bengal

coordinate_to_index_formula.notes: yCoordinates array in NISAR GCOV is ordered North-to-South (monotonically decreasing); hence row index 0 corresponds to max Northing.

native_10m.compression_savings_vs_full_scene: 95.6% reduction in RAM and storage requirement

multi_looked_20m.compression_savings_vs_full_scene: 98.9% reduction in RAM and storage requirement

cross_frequency_resampling_plan.master_grid: WGS 84 / UTM zone 45N at standard 20m x 20m grid posting
cross_frequency_resampling_plan.l_band_treatment: Native 10m or 20m GCOV power extracted via row/column slicing, then reprojected/resampled to master grid using area-weighted multi-look averaging
cross_frequency_resampling_plan.s_band_treatment: S-SAR GCOV power layers resampled to the identical master grid using bilinear interpolation on linear power
cross_frequency_resampling_plan.radiometric_preservation: Never use nearest-neighbor on backscatter power (avoids pixel-drop artifacts); never use high-order spline (avoids negative power overshoots); discrete masks resampled with nearest-neighbor
